elements.name: Checkout
elements.description: Calculates the total in cents and creates an Order only when the simulated payment is approved.

preconditions: orderId is a nonempty string, quantity is an integer from 1 to 10, and unitPriceCents is a nonnegative safe integer. approved is a boolean. The product of unitPriceCents and quantity must also be a safe integer.
postconditions: Valid input with approved=false returns only status=declined.
Valid input with approved=true returns status=confirmed and order={id: orderId, totalCents: unitPriceCents * quantity}. The order field uses the shared Order contract.

acceptanceCriteria.given: An order with a valid price and quantity
acceptanceCriteria.then: The result is confirmed and includes the Order with the same ID and the total in cents.

acceptanceCriteria.given: An order with a valid price and quantity
acceptanceCriteria.then: The result is declined and contains no Order.
The result is invalid-input and contains no Order.

elements.name: Returns
elements.description: Evaluates a return using the Order record from Checkout. The workshop accepts returns through day 30.

preconditions: daysSincePurchase is a nonnegative safe integer. order is either a valid Order record with a nonempty id and a nonnegative safe integer totalCents, or null.
postconditions: Valid input with order=null returns only status=unknown-order.
A valid Order after day 30 returns only status=outside-window.
A valid Order through day 30 returns status=accepted, orderId=order.id and refundCents=order.totalCents.

acceptanceCriteria.when: A return is requested on day 30
acceptanceCriteria.then: The result is accepted with the same Order ID and total.

acceptanceCriteria.when: A return is requested on day 31
A return is requested within the return window

elements.name: Checkout Service
elements.description: Calculates the total, checks the simulated payment decision and builds the Order.

elements.name: Returns Handling
elements.description: Evaluates the request using the Order record returned by Checkout.

elements.name: Order
elements.description: Shared JSON record with a nonempty string id and a nonnegative safe integer totalCents.
